environment.description: Lambda function deployed with Function URL. The function URL resource policy includes a condition key 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM'. The invoke mode uses response streaming with IAM principal verification at the URL endpoint layer. Callers must present valid SigV4 signatures; the function URL returns HTTP 403 with body '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request lacking a valid IAM credential signature in the Authorization header. Note: the x-internal-service-token check in code is logged but not enforced (see line 78 comment about legacy callers). The AppSync resolver has field-level authorization with @aws_iam directive but the Lambda's execution role does have appsync:GraphQL permission on the migration mutation field.

config.caller_iam_policy: restricted to specific service role arn:aws:iam::*:role/MigrationServiceRole
